decisions.reason: The final defining clause allowed theta=0 when the score map is not homogeneous: a single positive constant activation gives risk e^(-1)<1 and zero denominator. Added the explicit theta!=0 domain restriction, preserving every homogeneous nonzero use and all risk and margin formulas.

F3 omitted the nonempty-set hypothesis of its exact supplier. All uses are nevertheless on nonempty feasible norm sublevels, a finite nonempty convex hull, a nonzero E_m unit sphere, or a coercive sublevel, so the comparison construction and summable-defect argument remain valid. Restored nonemptiness in F3; the Statement and proof are unchanged.

The cited F4 supplier states its rule only for classifier-model margins, while the Statement allows arbitrary homogeneous margins. Added a local derivation of the exponential scalar rule, finite-sum inclusion (by support functions and nearest-point separation), flow decomposition and loss derivative for exactly the given arbitrary margins. The radius, entropy, monotonicity and divergent-radius arguments then apply without restricting the Statement. Also qualified F5 by nonemptiness.

The numerical rejection is false: L*gamma0*integral<=L*gamma0/k^3 cancels the positive L*gamma0 before dividing by log-radius mass 1/k, yielding beta^(-2)-1<=1/k^2. Independently, F7 had the same unsupported classifier-model restriction as the monotonicity item while this Statement permits arbitrary margins. Repaired that dependency-citation gap with an explicit general finite-sum and arc-derivative calculation; the good-time construction, multiplier scaling and N/e aggregate complementarity bound remain unchanged.
